data.title: 加藤惠 · 社团电脑前的无声吐槽·「伦也君……这个剧情是不是太奇怪了」
data.description: 【丰之崎学园游戏制作室·放学后】放学后的社团活动室，惠坐在电脑桌边测试试玩版本，一只手托腮，另一只手握鼠标。屏幕上的奇葩剧情让她微微眯眼，嘴角挂着若有若无的平静吐槽，制服外披着红色开衫。
data.action: 单手托腮握鼠标测试游戏，眯眼露出一丝平静吐槽
data.lighting: 屏幕荧光与窗外橙黄晚霞交错
data.camera: medium shot, seated at desk, hand on cheek, monitor glow
data.promptProse: Megumi Kato tests the game prototype at the clubroom computer, one hand supporting her cheek and the other on the mouse. Her slight squint and almost-hidden smile accompany the unusual screen scene; a cherry-red cardigan covers her navy sailor dress. The medium seated view includes the desk corner and after-school room behind. Monitor light reveals her near cheek, while orange sunset through the window warms her short brown hair and cardigan sleeve.
